paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : LLaMA-2-7B
model_annotation: The graph illustrates the informativeness scores of LLaMA-2-7B across different conditions, comparing performance with and without extension. The x-axis represents the condition, ranging from 0 to 4, while the y-axis shows informativeness, scaled from 0.920 to 0.970. Two lines are plotted: a dashed blue line with circular markers labeled "w.o. extension," and a solid orange line with triangular markers labeled "extension." Both lines show a decreasing trend in informativeness as the condition number increases. At condition 0, the "w.o. extension" line starts at approximately 0.968, while the "extension" line begins slightly lower at around 0.967. By condition 4, the "w.o. extension" line reaches approximately 0.919, and the "extension" line ends at about 0.918. The "extension" line consistently remains slightly above the "w.o. extension" line across all conditions, indicating a marginally higher informativeness score in all cases.
